assets.version: 1.3 (cover and footers 'Version 1.3 · 21 October 2026')
assets.content_summary: 16-page daily plan: cover, an at-a-glance page and one page per day for Days 1-14. Each day page has a time estimate (20-60 min), today's objective, a 30-60 minute core task in three steps, the expected output ('save this'), what to open, an optional stretch, a notes box, a done checkbox and a progress bar. There are three milestones (Day 3 choose, Day 10 talk to real people, Day 14 decide) and four phases (Days 1-3, 4-9, 10-12, 13-14). Two honest limits are stated: replies take days, and a first sale is not guaranteed. A firm dated yes or deposit counts as a commitment, and fewer than five conversations means 'not enough information'.

assets.version: 1.3 (cover and footers 'Version 1.3 · 21 October 2026')
assets.content_summary: 4-page decision tool. Twelve questions are each scored 0-3 with an anchored guide, then a total of 36 that is 'context only, not the verdict'. Evidence gates are applied in order: Gate 1 enough evidence (Reach 0 or 1 → INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE); Gate 2 willingness (0 → STOP); Gate 3 demand gate with different standards for Service, Product and Slow-buying market; then total ≥24 → NEXT TEST or <24 → ADJUST if demand passes, and an ADJUST-or-STOP rule if it fails. Each of the four verdicts has a next-step paragraph. The final page ('After Day 14') invites buyers to reply with their verdict and mentions a planned optional membership.
